title: HMS Your Town: which British towns have had a warship named after them?
excerpt: I matched every Royal Navy ship in Wikidata to the British towns they are named after: 394 ships for 135 towns. Gloucester and Newcastle have had nine each; Lancaster four; Barrow none.
seo_description: 135 British towns and cities that gave their name to 394 Royal Navy warships, from 1650 to today, mapped from Wikidata.
header_alt: Title card reading 'HMS Your Town' on parchment beside a map of Great Britain and Northern Ireland with circles on the towns that gave their name to Royal Navy ships, sized by the number of ships.
